title: Title/name of study [VARCHAR(100)]
description: Long description of study (or filename) [optional, TEXT]
contact-name: Name of the person to contact regarding this data [VARCHAR(100)]

datasets.dataset-size: Size of dataset, must not be negative [INTEGER]
datasets.browser-uri: Set this to offer the Graphical Browser for the dataset; leave it out to hide that tab [optional, VARCHAR(200)]
datasets.beacon-uri: Set this to offer the Beacon for the dataset; leave it out to hide that tab [optional, VARCHAR(200)]

version.terms: Terms of use for this dataset (or filename) [TEXT]
version.var-call-ref: Reference genome used; must match reference_build or reference_name of an existing row in data.reference_sets [VARCHAR]
version.available-from: Date of publication, defaults to now [optional, TIMESTAMP]
files: Path to a file released with this version, readable from where the loader runs; its name and size are taken from disk and it is offered for download behind the same login and access application as the rest of the version [optional]
